Asset type: Astral launch greeting, FINAL sequential animation sheet, part6 of6.

The greeting has finished; quietly settle the slightly high IMAGE-LEFT flipper DOWN and INWARD into the same relaxed low pose as the right flipper, then let tiny lower-scallop motion decay into a calm frontal idle-ready pose. No wave, no bounce, no new blink. The last frame95 is held afterward. This is a one-shot ENDING, not a loop back to entrance.

2. CANONICAL MASTER: approved material, eyes and intended relaxed small-flipper geometry. Both master flippers sit low close against body and bend softly INWARD, approximately mirror-symmetric. Gradually bring the current left flipper into that relaxed orientation. Do NOT abruptly adopt this master's narrower/taller body or large full-image scale; preserve current animation's rounded body proportions and optical size.
3. PREVIOUS PART5 source sheet: authoritative current source-cell optical scale, proportions, constant upper-left illumination and previous small movement. Keep visible body height about251–255 SOURCE pixels on the1254px sheet. No enlargement or shrinking to fill cells.
4. STORYBOARD: ONLY last calm pose intent. Do not copy its framing, blink, gestures, earlier entrance, height or different proportions.

Layout: one square transparent PNG approximately1254x1254, exactly4 columns x4 rows of16 regular equal square cells, chronological row-major order. Same complete spirit in each cell; fixed frontal nearly orthographic camera. Constant optical volume, body height, eye size and eye separation. Consistent optical centering with safe empty alpha gutters around every pose, including sides and bottom scallops. No sprite cropping or touching adjacent cells, no row-dependent zoom or center jumps. Every pose is a real subtly redrawn in-between; do not duplicate a static frame, but do not invent new gestures to force difference.

Motion in precise order:
ROW1 global80,81,82,83:80 almost matches79. In81 left flipper lowers a tiny amount and begins turning its tip inward toward body;82 a tiny further descent/inward bend;83 nearly reaches the right flipper's relaxed height. Keep its short attached base and small size. Right flipper stays calm and low, no movement outward. BOTH eyes fully open.
ROW2 global84,85,86,87: gradually complete this small correction; by87 BOTH small flippers sit at approximately matching low heights and mirrored inward-curved relaxed orientations like the master, attached snugly to sides. Three lower scallops respond with very subtle delayed movement. Preserve broad current body volume, no squash or growing. Eyes open.
ROW3 global88,89,90,91: decay the remaining tiny organic motion of body and three lower scallops. Both flippers stay relaxed and close to body, no new flap or lifting. The whole spirit becomes steadily quieter, upright and frontal. Eyes remain the same open white vertical ovals.
ROW4 global92,93,94,95: calm frontal idle-ready pose, both small low relaxed flippers, three rounded lower scallops. Tiny genuine redraws with nearly imperceptible decreasing changes, not exact pixel duplicates. By95 motion almost stops, ready to hold. All eyes fully OPEN. Do not restart entrance or create a looping seam.

Identity and anatomy invariants: dense frosted pearl icy silver-blue jelly-glass spirit with a soft domed head, subtle lilac and cool blue edges; exactlyTWO small attached flippers and exactlyTHREE rounded bottom scallops; exactlyTWO glowing white vertical oval eyes. No pupils. No extra lower left remnant when flipper moves, third flap, long arm, fingers, human palm, detached sphere or tubular limb. No new facial expression, narrowing or eye zoom. Constant soft studio illumination from UPPER LEFT with smooth stable highlights, no random light flicker or texture changes, not a hollow shell. Friendly settled presence.
Backdrop: actual transparent alpha with soft semitransparent edges preserved. No background, checkerboard, gridlines, frames, labels, numbering, text, watermark, floor, cast shadow, particles, props, costume, logos, nose, mouth, blush, inner core or new eye blink. Do not copy transparency-view display artifacts from inputs. Only the16 clean final successive spirit drawings on transparency.
